violations.description: Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not properly protected from potential contamination. - Opened boxes of food items under the condenser in the freezer need to be closed to protect from ice.--Food item was not stored in a clean, dry location a minimum of 6 inches above the floor. - Three cases of food items stored on the floor.

General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. -Walk in freezer condenser has a build up of ice.
Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item - to go containers -was not stored in a proper location to be protected from contamination. Do not store on the floor.
